# Ceiling

Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Ceiling(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | The number to round. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The least integer that is not below value, so a negative number goes toward zero. The result is exact when value is exact. Never null.

## Example

`Ceiling(2.1)` returns `3`.

`Ceiling(-2.7)` returns `-2`.
